title: Xdrip open in small window on lemfo11 android watch
body:
Hi,
I installed xdrip on lemfo11 android watch.
It worked well but now when opened appears in a small window and not using all clock display.
I can use it but when I did a new sensor set up the window where ask date or sensor type does not show buttons because goes on invisible area .
I don't know if this is due from xdrip update or lemfo android update.  How could resolve or workaround the setting problem.


Best regards

comments.body: Close the issue..I reset the watch and reinstalled.Now is fine
